# Distributed_Sinkhorn_Iteration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A distributed iterative algorithm for aligning probability distributions across network nodes, equivalent to solving optimal transport problems in a decentralized manner. It enables local interactions to achieve global self-organization in large-scale networks, providing a concrete computational primitive for TCC architectures.
